svg.aria-label: Where I've worked. 2024 · now: Technical Lead · Java Developer, Internal Revenue Service. Technical lead on a data platform that holds hundreds of millions of records; designed its Version 4 data model and API contract. 2023 · 2024: SDET, Internal Revenue Service. Designed the team's automated test solution across API, contract, data and end-to-end layers. 2022 · 2024: Co-founder · CEO, TEK School. Ran the school with a team of sixteen and taught about 1,000 people software engineering and test automation. 2021 · 2022: Software Engineer in Test, FINRA. Test frameworks for the APIs behind regulated stock market data. 2020 · now: Founder, Dev Fusion Lab. My own studio. Panjera is in production; Jeeraph is in build. 2020 · 2021: SDET, Internal Revenue Service. Reusable Java frameworks for functional, regression and accessibility testing of tax applications. 2019 · 2020: Automation Engineer · QA Lead, USPTO. Sole quality owner for an internal audit system; took it from manual testing to automated regression. 2015 · 2018: SDET, Atos. Java, Selenium, REST Assured and JMeter frameworks for client delivery teams.
